segments.name: Autoimmune therapeutics
segments.description: Develops telitacicept, a fusion protein licensed from RemeGen, for autoimmune diseases.
segments.evidence: The Company operates and manages its business as one reportable and operating segment, centered around the commercial development of its product candidates.

changes.text: In 2025 the Company wound down its then clinical and manufacturing operations under a restructuring plan.
changes.evidence: On May 5, 2025, the Company's board of directors approved the wind down of the Company's then clinical and manufacturing operations and the initiation of a process to explore strategic alternatives to maximize shareholder value (the "Restructuring Plan").
